summary: This bill directs the Attorney General to establish a national working group to study and recommend strategies and resources for identifying and rescuing children from sexual exploitation and abuse, including those depicted in child sexual abuse material and victims of contact offenses.

scores.thoughts: This bill is entirely focused on establishing a working group to study and recommend strategies for identifying and rescuing child victims of sexual exploitation and abuse, and apprehending offenders. This directly relates to strengthening law enforcement efforts and criminal justice processes for these specific crimes.
